# Litmatch Service Map

> Interactive map of how the 25 services/modules of Litmatch coordinate and why (72 audited cross-service flows). The page is large; for machine reading use the context pack below (many small markdown files with stable ids).

- [Context pack index](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/llms.txt): start here
- [Service map data per service](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/index.md): collaborators with why / if missing, techniques, Q&A, findings
- [Flows](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/flows/index.md): the 72 sequence flows, one file each
- [Feature slices](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/slices/index.md): follow one feature from screen to database
